name: bare-language
description: Syntax highlighting, snippets, and one-key running for the BARE programming language (.bare files).

bare.interpreterPath.markdownDescription:
Path to the `bare` interpreter. Leave as `bare` if it is on your `PATH` (the standalone runtime installs to `~/.local/bin/bare`); otherwise give an absolute path.

BARE's IDE remains the primary way to run programs — this extension drives the standalone runtime, which takes a filename and nothing else.

bare.saveBeforeRun.description: Save the file automatically before running it.

bare.runInTerminal.markdownDescription:
Run in an integrated terminal, which keeps `input` usable.

Turn this **off** to capture output in an Output channel instead, which is what populates the Problems panel with BARE's errors. A program that calls `input` will end at once in that mode, because there is no terminal behind it.

contributes._comment: No problemMatchers contribution: BARE reports `Error on line <n>: <message>` with no filename, and a VS Code problem matcher pattern cannot attribute an error without one. The extension parses that format itself and pins the diagnostic to the file it ran — see publishDiagnostics in extension.js.
